statement: Snp 4.9 (Sn 842) directly places maññati in an equal/superior/inferior comparison structure and links that self-positioning to dispute.

evidence_refs.locator: Sn 842: samo visesī uda vā nihīno / yo maññati so vivadetha tena

provenance.review_note: Direct Pāli review supports this narrow claim; salvaged audit remains an evidence reference, not a semantic dependency. This does not make every maññati occurrence a technical identity term.
